title: Hermanos Espinoza Announces 2026 Linaje U.S.A. Tour: See the Dates
summary: The 17-date trek is in support of the música mexicana duo's debut studio album, Linaje.
contentText:
Hermanos Espinoza is hitting the road in 2026 with its Linaje U.S.A. Tour, Billboard can exclusively announce Monday (April 13).

Produced by Live Nation, the 17-date trek will kick off July 24 at San Diego’s SOMA and wrap at The Criterion in Oklahoma City on Sept. 5. The latter is one of three non-Live Nation shows. In between, the música mexicana duo will make pit stops in key cities including Los Angeles, New York, Chicago and Houston.

In support of its debut studio album, Linaje , released in March, the pair will serenade fans with songs such as “Dios Por Delante,” “Freestyle,” “Modelo V” and “La Racha,” all of which have made them a household name.

Hailing from McAllen, Texas, the rising regional Mexican act — comprised of brothers Joel (vocals, accordion) and Leonel Espinoza (vocals, bajo sexto, bajo quinto) — is known for its soulful take on corridos while embracing norteño roots.

The tour comes on the heels of Hermanos Espinoza performing at the Billboard House during the 2026 SXSW Festival and signing a management deal with George Prajin and Peso Pluma’s Double P Management in 2025.

Tickets for the Linaje U.S.A. Tour begin with pre-sale at 10 a.m. local time on April 14, and general sale at 10 a.m. local time on April 17 via Live Nation’s website . See the complete tour dates below:
